draft.transcript:
So, um, yeah - where do I even start... okay so the biggest headache this quarter, honestly, was the vehicle fleet issue, we had two of our four survey vehicles down for almost a month, mechanical problems, and that really messed with our household survey schedule in the Rift Valley sites. That's probably the main thing I want flagged as a challenge.
Oh - and I should say, this is the policy and partnerships side, George Wanjiru, sorry I should've said that at the start.
Anyway, um, where was I. Right, so despite the vehicle thing, we still managed to sign the co-funding agreement with the regional livestock policy platform, that's actually a pretty big deal for us, took like eight months of negotiation, so I'd count that as a success, definitely.
In terms of, uh, how far along we are - I'd say we're... maybe halfway, honestly hard to say exactly, somewhere in the 45 to 50 percent range, if I had to pin down a single number I'd probably say 48.
If you want a traffic light colour for this one, I'd say yellow - the vehicle situation dragged us down, but the agreement is a big enough win to keep us out of red.
Support needed - yeah, we could really use some help from legal on reviewing the co-funding agreement wording before we countersign, that's kind of urgent actually.
Oh, and this was for quarter two, by the way, in case that wasn't clear.
